description: Regulated Private Water Utilities is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Water Management. This points layer displays the general locations of regulated private water utilities across the province of British Columbia. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Water Management. Its tags are water licensing, water utilities. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-03-16 as the last update. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
